resultText:
Committed. No UI changes in this task, so no screenshots needed.

<<<JSON
{ "summary": "Set up the project skeleton: package.json (type module, engines node>=24, typescript + @types/node as the only dev deps), tsconfig.json for type-check-only use, extended .gitignore with SQLite artifacts, a smoke test proving node:sqlite works, and a short README. All three gate commands (install, typecheck, test) pass.", "notes_for_reviewer": "The task spec's test script `node --test test/` fails on this Node version (26.7) — a bare directory path with a trailing slash gets misparsed as a module to require, raising MODULE_NOT_FOUND. I used `node --test` (no path argument) instead, which does Node's default test-discovery and correctly picks up test/smoke.test.ts; verified this is a real Node CLI quirk, not a project issue, by reproducing it directly with `node --test test/` outside npm. Documented this in docs/STATE.md since later tasks' per-task verify commands reference specific files like `node --test test/store.test.ts`, which work fine (only the bare-directory-with-trailing-slash form is broken)." }
JSON>>>
